messages.subject: Shiny Select input
parts:
I am new to shiny and have been reading the tutorials and looking at the gallery
One of them I am looking at is the widget for basic data table.
How do you change the select input to read a csv file?
Currently they have
selectInput ("man",
"Manufacturer",
c ("All",
unique (as.character (mpg $ manufacturer))))

How do you replace the mpg $ manufacturer with a csv file and reference a column?

I have tried to replace it but the drop menu shows the whole csv file url.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Select input
parts:
In that case, in ui.R but before you start your UI definition, load the dataset:

mydata <- read.csv("path-to-file")

Then the selectInput choices attribute would be something like unique(as.character(mydata$foo)), where "foo" would be the column name you want to use.
